description: This file defines the DataGroupService class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing data group permissions, API permissions, and data group retrieval operations as part of the authorization service layer.

classes.name: DataGroupService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to access and manipulate data group permissions and related authorization data.

methods.name: getDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the DataGroupDao instance used for data operations.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Retrieves permissions for specified data groups, user role, and scope (self or non-self).

methods.name: getDataGroups
methods.description: Fetches all data groups defined in the system.

methods.name: getDataGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a data group entity by name.

methods.name: getApiPermissions
methods.description: Gathers API permissions for a specified API class and roles, consolidating permission flags into a ResourcePermission object.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionCollection
methods.description: Constructs a collection of data group permissions, combining permissions with logical OR if multiple permissions exist for the same data group.
